author: _DipperPines
body:
Hey Guys!

So, today I want to know, what the the average avicus player want to see in a Nebula Map? Do you want it to be a long match? Do you want a short match? Detailed Maps? Big Maps? Small Maps? Basic Maps? Let me know! (I am making another map and before I post it I want to know what the community wants.)

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Anything but those massive 1,000,000 block wide and long maps covered in trees and massive hills and water and stairs and slabs and stuff. Those can be good, but they tend to be not so good.

Something simple. Try to have your own way of building, but look at the legends like G_SKIPPY if you need inspiration. Ternio is a 2 tiny rectangles, one smallish rectangle, and a massive circle yet it's one of the best maps here.
